scientific_integrity: The original invariant circle, known cofactor method, and classical angular slowing are acknowledged prior work. Claimed contribution is the simultaneous finite Floquet crossover. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to the invariant circle and the specified two-parameter approach for fixed b>0; neither global off-circle dynamics nor other parameter paths are established. Publication priority relative to inaccessible original 1958 material is uncertain.
title: A finite Floquet crossover at the double-zero arrest of Qin's invariant circle
